import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_ideal_nilpotence {p m : ℕ}   (I : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m))) (hI : I ≤ (Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m))} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m))))) : IsNilpotent I := by
  refine ⟨m, le_antisymm ?_ bot_le⟩
  calc
    I ^ m ≤ (Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m))} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m)))) ^ m :=
      pow_le_pow_left' hI m
    _ = ⊥ := by
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      have hp : (p : ZMod (p ^ m)) ^ m = 0 := by
        rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
        exact ZMod.natCast_self _
      simp [hp]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_ideal_nilpotence {p m : ℕ}   (I : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m))) (hI : I ≤ (Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m))} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m))))) : IsNilpotent I := by
  let J : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m)) :=
    Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m))} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m)))
  change I ≤ J at hI
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, I ^ n ≤ J ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        exact le_rfl
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
        exact Ideal.mul_mono ih hI
  refine ⟨m, le_antisymm ?_ (bot_le : (⊥ : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m))) ≤ I ^ m)⟩
  calc
    I ^ m ≤ J ^ m := hpow m
    _ = Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m)) ^ m} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m))) := by
      dsimp [J]
      exact Ideal.span_singleton_pow _ _
    _ = ⊥ := by
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
      rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ZMod.natCast_self]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_ideal_nilpotence {p m : ℕ}   (I : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m))) (hI : I ≤ (Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m))} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m))))) : IsNilpotent I := by
  let J : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m)) :=
    Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m))} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m)))
  have h_containment : ∀ K : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m)), K ≤ J → IsNilpotent K := by
    intro K hK
    refine ⟨Nat.succ m, ?_⟩
    have hpowJ : J ^ Nat.succ m = ⊥ := by
      have hdiv : p ^ m ∣ p ^ Nat.succ m := by
        refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
        simp [Nat.pow_succ]
      have hzero : ((p : ZMod (p ^ m)) ^ Nat.succ m) = 0 := by
        have hcast : ((p ^ Nat.succ m : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ m)) = 0 := by
          exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff (a := p ^ Nat.succ m) (b := p ^ m)).2 hdiv
        simpa [Nat.cast_pow] using hcast
      simp [J, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, hzero]
    have hpowK : K ^ Nat.succ m ≤ J ^ Nat.succ m := by
      apply pow_le_pow_left'
      exact hK
    have hzeroK : K ^ Nat.succ m ≤ ⊥ := by
      rw [hpowJ] at hpowK
      exact hpowK
    simpa [Ideal.zero_eq_bot] using (le_antisymm hzeroK bot_le)
  exact h_containment I (by simpa [J] using hI)

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_ideal_nilpotence {p m : ℕ}   (I : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m))) (hI : I ≤ (Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m))} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m))))) : IsNilpotent I := by
  let J : Ideal (ZMod (p ^ m)) :=
    Ideal.span ({(p : ZMod (p ^ m))} : Set (ZMod (p ^ m)))
  have hIJ : I ≤ J := hI
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, I ^ n ≤ J ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simp
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
        exact Ideal.mul_mono ih hIJ
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (hpow m).trans (by
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ZMod.natCast_self]
      simp)
  · exact bot_le
